# Baker Production

> Baker Production is a real estate media studio based in Perth, Western Australia. It provides property photography, drone and aerial photography, listing video, floor plans, twilight photography, 3D virtual tours, virtual staging and agent headshots for real estate agents, property managers and developers across the Perth metropolitan area.

Key facts, current as at 24 August 2026:

- Location: Perth, Western Australia. Phone +61 466 789 522. Email admin@bakerproduction.com.
- Coverage: Perth metro, Alkimos in the north to Rockingham in the south, coast through to the Perth Hills. No travel loading inside that area. Mandurah, Peel and regional WA quoted individually.
- Turnaround: photography, drone and floor plans are delivered the next day, guaranteed. Video is delivered in two days. Virtual staging renders in minutes.
- Volume: more than 1,500 properties shot.
- All prices include GST and are quoted in Australian dollars.
- Entry pricing: rental photography $159, sales photography $189, floor plans from $159, drone $220, 3D virtual tour $159, listing video $450, agent headshots $220 for two agents.
- Packages: Essential $299, Premium $375, Social Media Lite $439, Core Listing $549, Signature $750, Elite Listing $1,299.
- Virtual staging, decluttering, day-to-dusk and rain cleanup start at $1.50 per image through Baker Studio, the company's own self-serve rendering platform. Premium human-built 3D staging is $25 per image.
- Every virtually enhanced image is automatically marked as virtually enhanced, in line with Australian Consumer Law disclosure obligations.

## Services

- [Real estate photography Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/real-estate-photography-perth.html): Sales shoots $189 with unlimited edited images, rentals $159. 60 minutes on site, next-day delivery.
- [Real estate videography Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/real-estate-videography-perth.html): Listing videos $450, day-to-night $650, social reels $300, vertical walkthroughs from $87. Two-day delivery.
- [Drone and aerial photography Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/drone-photography-perth.html): $220 for five edited aerials with road overlays and location pins. Flown under CASA commercial rules.
- [Real estate floor plans Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/floor-plans-perth.html): $159 to 200m2, $199 to 300m2, $239 to 500m2. Redraws $30, redraw plus site plan $45. Measured on site.
- [Twilight and day-to-dusk photography Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/twilight-photography-perth.html): Shot twilight $75 as an add-on, digital day-to-dusk conversion from $1.50 per image.
- [Virtual staging Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/virtual-staging-perth.html): Staging, decluttering, object removal, day-to-dusk and rain cleanup from $1.50 per image, rendered in two to five minutes.
- [3D virtual tours Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/virtual-tours-perth.html): $159 for an interactive 360-degree tour, any size property.
- [Rental property photography Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/rental-property-photography-perth.html): $159 per property, up to 20 wide images, multiple properties scheduled as a run.
- [Real estate agent headshots Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/agent-headshots-perth.html): $220 for two agents, fully edited.
